note: THE CONTROL, and it corrects the census: kg ALREADY AGREES about a symbol that was never declared. Both sides answer (error ("Invalid error symbol" u0-never-declared)). Phase 28's remeasurement (section 6.2) prints this shape as kg's WRONG answer against an Emacs of (my-err nil); the difference is that its Emacs side had a `put' in front of it. So the divergence is entirely about whether `signal' consults the plist -- with no plist, Emacs answers exactly what kg answers -- and an implementation that made every unknown symbol signalable would fail here rather than pass.
